Use @Image1 as the starting frame.
Steady tracking shot follows @Image2 as she walks barefoot along the wet packed sand at the water’s edge. She glances down at the @Image3 in her hand with a small private smile, then slips it back into her pocket and keeps walking forward into the open day. Shirt fabric billows behind her in the breeze; hair drifts freely; footprints appear in wet sand and lightly wash as foamy waves roll in.

gentle ocean waves rolling and washing ashore, light coastal breeze. soft barefoot steps on wet sand, shirt fabric fluttering, faint clink of lipstick tube into pocket.

Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
